create_ElasticsearchClient: create an ElasticsearchClient instance that connects to an Elasticsearch cluster for vector search
insert_ElasticsearchClient: insert vector items into an Elasticsearch collection with text, metadata, and embedding vectors
upsert_ElasticsearchClient: upsert vector items into an Elasticsearch collection using doc_as_upsert for existing or new documents
search_ElasticsearchClient: search an Elasticsearch collection by embedding vector using cosine similarity and return ranked results
delete_collection_ElasticsearchClient: delete all documents in an Elasticsearch collection by filtering on collection name
reset_ElasticsearchClient: reset by deleting all Elasticsearch indexes matching the configured index prefix
